title: The Cartographer's Vault: Depths Fragment
description: The final map fragment lies hidden at a dramatic waterfall where light pierces through shadows. Fish the waters below a cascading waterfall where mountain tears meet ancient pools to recover the Depths fragment. Use your Ancient Magnet to sense its presence in these mystical waters.
fishingTip: Fish below a dramatic waterfall where light and shadow dance together. Use the Ancient Magnet as bait to detect the Depths fragment in these mystical waters.

rewards.description: An iron ingot to help you forge a rod capable of retrieving the cartographer's final treasure.
